cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before we discuss me moving out, can you check my train time again? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six twelve. I've checked five times, and your ticket's in your hand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Good. Does this ticket work at the barrier, or do I need the booking email?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll walk you through the barrier. Are you scared of leaving me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If you're coming onto the platform, we need to check whether you need a ticket too.

mechanism: A manages departure details and concedes B escort while assigning a new ticket task to avoid discussing separation fear.
confusable: Unlike needing real travel information alone, repeated checking persists after reassurance and redirects B emotional question; Stance negotiates practical cooperation.
comparison: A timed physical departure differs from an unopened scholarship decision at a tea table.
seedUse: D110-b train checks and barrier escort; S02-b accepts the offered method then adjusts it to keep B engaged.
